Services.Name: Random Steam Game
Services.Summary: Stops library paralysis by choosing a game for you.
Services.Description: A fast random game picker for public Steam libraries. It resolves Steam identities, loads owned games, applies exclusions and filters, and returns a random game.

Services.Name: ntfy
Services.Summary: Delivers push notifications from applications and infrastructure.
Services.Description: A self-hosted notification service that accepts simple HTTP requests and delivers real-time push notifications to subscribed devices. It is used for application alerts, monitoring events, and operational notifications.

Services.Name: Mission Control Dashboard
Services.Summary: A private operations console for monitoring the JoyfulReaper service stack.
Services.Description: An authenticated Blazor dashboard for viewing Mission Control events, service status, container health, protocol probes, archive statistics, and detailed event payloads.

Services.Name: HappyEcho
Services.Summary: A modern implementation of the classic Echo protocol.
Services.Description: Accepts a TCP connection on port 7 and sends received data back to the client.

Services.Name: HappyDiscard
Services.Summary: A modern implementation of the classic Discard protocol.
Services.Description: Accepts data over TCP port 9 and discards every byte without decoding, storing, logging, or echoing it.

Services.Name: HappyQOTD
Services.Summary: Classic Quote of the Day over TCP with a matching HTTP API.
Services.Description: Serves one persisted quote for the current UTC day through TCP port 17 and a companion JSON API.

Services.Name: HappyFinger
Services.Summary: Finger a Steam ID to receive a random game recommendation.
Services.Description: A modern .NET implementation of the Finger protocol. A Steam ID supplied as the username returns a random game from that public Steam library.

Services.Name: HappyDaytime
Services.Summary: Connect to receive the current server time.
Services.Description: A modern .NET implementation of the Daytime Protocol. Clients connect over TCP and receive the current UTC timestamp as an ASCII response.

Services.Name: HappyGopher
Services.Summary: A real Gopher server for text-first browsing.
Services.Description: Serves a Gopher hierarchy over TCP port 70 for simple, text-oriented navigation.

Services.Name: IT-Tools
Services.Summary: A public collection of browser-based developer utilities.
Services.Description: Provides encoders, decoders, converters, formatters, generators, networking helpers, and other small developer utilities.

Services.Name: Mission Control Gateway
Services.Summary: Receives external events and publishes them internally.
Services.Description: Accepts generic integration events and signed GitHub webhooks, validates them, wraps them in a common envelope, and publishes them to NATS JetStream.

Services.Name: Mission Control Archive
Services.Summary: Maintains a durable history of integration events.
Services.Description: Consumes the complete Mission Control event stream and persists original event envelopes and payloads in SQLite for investigation.

Services.Name: Mission Control GitActivity
Services.Summary: Turns GitHub push events into a website-friendly feed.
Services.Description: Consumes GitHub push events, filters repositories and branches, and stores a sanitized commit projection in SQLite.

Services.Name: NATS JetStream
Services.Summary: Provides durable event streaming for Mission Control.
Services.Description: The message broker behind Mission Control. JetStream persists integration events and delivers them to durable consumers.

Services.Name: Beszel
Services.Summary: Lightweight host and container resource monitoring.
Services.Description: Provides container, CPU, memory, network, uptime, and host status information for the VPS.

Services.Name: Beszel Agent
Services.Summary: Collects host and container metrics for Beszel.
Services.Description: Reads host and Docker statistics and reports them to the private Beszel monitoring dashboard.

Services.Name: Uptime Kuma
Services.Summary: Checks whether exposed services are actually reachable.
Services.Description: Performs scheduled availability checks against websites, APIs, and network services and provides alerting when they fail.
